cat > /tmp/validate.py <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, cv2, sys
inp=pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1],index_col=0); out=pd.read_csv(sys.argv[2],index_col=0)
img=cv2.imread(sys.argv[3]); H,W=img.shape[:2]
assert list(inp.columns)==list(out.columns) and len(inp)==len(out)
acc=np.zeros((H,W),int); bad=0
for i,r in out.iterrows():
    xs=np.array(r.coords_x.split(','),int); ys=np.array(r.coords_y.split(','),int)
    pts={(a,b) for a,b in zip(xs,ys)}
    if len(pts)==4 and len({p[0] for p in pts})==2: print('rect',i); bad+=1
    assert r.xmin==xs.min() and r.xmax==xs.max() and r.ymin==ys.min() and r.ymax==ys.max()
    m=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8); cv2.fillPoly(m,[np.stack([xs,ys],1)],1)
    nc,_=cv2.connectedComponents(m,connectivity=4)
    if nc-1!=1: print('noncontig',i,nc-1); bad+=1
    acc+=m
    cv2.polylines(img,[np.stack([xs,ys],1)],True,(0,255,0),1)
for i,r in inp.iterrows():
    xs=np.array(r.coords_x.split(','),int); ys=np.array(r.coords_y.split(','),int)
    cv2.polylines(img,[np.stack([xs,ys],1)],True,(255,0,0),1)
print('overlap pixels',(acc>1).sum(),'bad',bad)
cv2.imwrite('/tmp/overlay.png',cv2.resize(img,None,fx=2,fy=2,interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST))
EOF
python /tmp/validate.py demo_metadata.csv /tmp/outtest/demo_metadata.csv demo_rgb.png
